title: Part Two: Egyptian Rule and the Occupation

sections.brief: 1949–1967 under Egypt, from the Cold War volume: al-Burj, the 1955 raid and uprising, the fida'i units, the 1956 occupation and killings, withdrawal, UNEF; the Sinai resettlement scheme. Figures: timeline; comparison of tolls.
June 1967: capture, census, military government; the insurgency and Sharon's 1971 campaign; relocation plans. Figures: stats; timeline.
Labor in Israel, land and water, the settlements from 1970, the Civil Administration of 1982, the strip left out of Camp David. Figures: money chain; comparison.
